_why: Architecture plan step 0 (2026-09-30): the surface may shrink but not grow without a deliberate edit here. 64 hosted tools, 68 cxp commands and 36 tables carried the usage in which ~a quarter to a third did 90% of the work. Raising a number is a decision: say why in the commit.
_raised: 2026-11-10: cxp_commands 62→60 — `cxp spine-lint` and `cxp seal-sweep` retired; the cp-hosted `spine_lint` / `seal_sweep` verbs run the same engine code with no local credentials. Drew's call 2026-11-10 (the CLI copies failed whenever 1Password was locked).
2026-09-30: cxp_commands 68→69 for `cxp health` (step 3, daily health line); mc2_tables 36→37 for `webhook_runs` (step 3, a run record on every webhook path).

2026-10-01: hosted_tools 64→71 for step 5b — the stdio server (17 tools) was retired and the seven verbs only it carried (fetch_project_source, compare_project_sources, pull_document_comments, push_to_dropbox, preflight, list_vendors, list_rfp_respondents) moved to hosted. Net MCP surface across both servers fell 81→71; cxp_commands fell 69→68 (`cxp mcp`) without a ceiling change.
2026-10-01: hosted_tools 55→58 — worksets kept (Drew: an idea not yet executed); open_workset, list_worksets, describe_workset restored.

2026-10-27: hosted_tools 58→59 for `ingest_url` (#350) — URL sources had no path into the store and form-gated pages landed as if they were documents. Drew approved the added hosted surface on 2026-10-12. `push_to_dropbox` gained an `ingest` option, not a new tool.

2026-10-30: hosted_tools 59→60 for `add_project_link` (#370) — work behind a login (Figma files, claude.ai Artifacts, repos) had no record in the source store or the spine; `ingest_url` cannot serve it because it fetches. Drew approved starting #370 on 2026-10-30 and lifted the freeze for it.
2026-10-30: Drew: no surface freeze is in effect; `_frozen_until` removed. Ceilings stay as a count guard — raise with a reason in the commit.

2026-10-30: cxp_commands 53→54 for `cxp aliases` (#387) — alias candidates found at ingest need a human accept/reject that writes `.cp-engine.toml`; config is never auto-written. Drew approved building #387 on 2026-10-30.

2026-10-30: cxp_commands 54→60 for `cxp session` + start/end/list/commit/register (#394) — two sessions in one clone committed each other's files and raced sync; a per-session worktree, a scoped commit-and-push, and a registry the hooks feed need their own verbs (`register` is the hook entry point). Drew approved building #394 on 2026-10-30.

2026-10-30: cxp_commands 60→61 for `cxp skills` (#395) — people did not know which cp skills exist or the words that start them; `/cp-help`, the session-start hint and the shareable guide page all read this one command so they cannot disagree. Drew approved #395 on 2026-10-30 (no surface freeze).

2026-10-30: cxp_commands 61→62 for `cxp folders` (#396) — 17 active workstreams had Dropbox or Drive on with no folder (silently ingesting nothing) and no read-only way to see which folders exist against the convention or what to bind. Drew approved building #396 on 2026-10-30.

2026-11-07: hosted_tools 60→62 for `create_vendor` + `add_rfp_respondent` (#412) — the vendor registry and RFP pipeline could be read but not written, so adding Orbital Studios for sap-5198 on 11-04 took raw SQL (no attribution, no email_confidence check). Drew filed #412 asking for both verbs.

2026-11-11: mc2_tables 34→37 for `project_types`, `lesson_moments` and `lessons` (learning from projects, phases 0–1, mc-2 migs 215–217). Drew: "continuously learn from our projects"; approved the plan and asked for phases 0 and 1 on 2026-11-11. Types and moments are growable lists; lessons are one short lesson per row.

2026-11-11: hosted_tools 62→65 for `log_lesson`, `list_lessons` and `set_lesson` (learning from projects, phase 2). Drew asked for "remember this" in any session and owner review of lessons; three verbs rather than the plan's five: `set_lesson` covers confirm, retire and edit, and `list_lessons` covers lookouts, search and the review queue.

2026-11-11: mc2_tables 37→40 for `freelancer_reviews`, `contractor_hours` and (read-only) `payables` (learning phase 5, mc-2 mig 218). Drew asked to evaluate freelancers with a record of their projects and ratings, and to agree contractor hours before start and track them.

2026-11-11: hosted_tools 65→68 for `review_freelancer`, `set_contractor_hours` and `list_freelancers` (learning phase 5). Drew asked to rate freelancers per project, recommend from history, and agree and track contractor hours.
_lowered: 2026-10-01: step 5 retire list — hosted_tools 71→55 (16 zero-use/dormant tools retired: worksets, notes, step editors, etc.), cxp_commands 69→53 (11 dead commands, dates-loop, weekly-sort, snapshots, mcp), mc2_tables 37→34 (notes, worksets, spine_snapshots out of the registry). Frozen at these counts until 2026-11-01 (Drew): no raise without a reason in the commit.
